summary: The conversation directory provides the core data contracts and schemas required for exchanging messages with an AI system. It defines the structure of chat requests, responses, individual messages, and attachments to ensure consistent communication.
responsibilities: Define schema contracts for AI chat interactions
Model the structure of messages and message history
Specify requirements for sending messages and attachments
Normalize response formats for AI chat services
relationships: An AI chat request contains a history of messages and a current message input.
A message entity is composed of content and optional attachments.
The AI chat response wraps a message entity within a standardized result structure.
designDecisions: Use schema-based definitions for type safety
Decouple message content from transport metadata
Centralize common communication structures in a single directory
